title: The arc-topology and descent for étale cohomology
summary: Build the scheme arc-topology from valuation rings, prove the excision criterion and the coherent-topos pushout theorems, and apply them to torsion étale cohomology, constructible and perfect complexes, henselian completion and rigid generic fibres. Complete arc-sites and a perfectoid basis provide the shared descent interfaces used by prismatic and flat-cohomological applications.
readme: The roadmap constructs the rank-at-most-one valuative topology and its complete variants, with precise conventions for fields, coefficient torsion and coherent descent. It culminates in the arc-excision criterion, torsion étale and constructible/perfect-complex descent, formal glueing, affine henselian comparison and rigid generic-fibre applications. Reader document: research/blueprint/readmes/ArcTopologyAndDescent.md. Scheme foundations, enhanced categories, perfect v-descent, perfectoid algebra and analytic geometry are imported from their canonical owners; the algebraic-space Tannaka registration gap is explicit in the packet.

stages.title: Valuation extensions and rank intervals
stages.description: Valuation-specific algebra: injective local extensions, absolute integral closedness, bounded aic extensions, finite-rank approximation and prime intervals.

stages.title: The scheme v- and h-topologies
stages.description: Scheme v-covers, the finitely presented h-site and universal descent; Rydh refinement; the converse h-descent criterion using the imported finite-inductive-level and forward blowup theorems; comparison on perfect schemes.

stages.title: Arc-covers and spectral submersions
stages.description: Define rank-at-most-one arc-covers and their finite affine covering families. Prove stability, the noetherian-target comparison, the affine universal-injectivity test, universal spectral submersion characterisation, inverse-limit stability and the rank-two splitting example.

stages.title: Finitary descent and valuation detection
stages.description: Define finitariness and universal descent with coherent totalizations, compact generation by cotruncated objects and descent-detecting families. Establish the filtered-totalization interchange and ultraproduct/aic-valuation detection, with the valuation-product component calculation. The continuous v-descent criterion follows here after filtered-totalization interchange. The valuation-product description also proves the infinite-chain non-quotient example and the obstruction to affine covers with only rank-one components.

stages.title: The arc-descent criterion
stages.description: Define excisiveness and aic-v-excision using the imported Milnor-square interface. Prove universal aic splitting with the corrected prime-extension lemma, interval induction, the equivalence of arc-descent and excision for finitary v-sheaves, and rank-at-most-one detection of equivalences.

stages.title: The coherent arc-topos and unrestricted excision
stages.description: Construct the bounded-cardinal arc-site, its comparison across cutoffs and its coherent topos. Prove valuation tests for coherent sheaves, the sheafified Milnor pushout and excision for every small-limit-valued arc-sheaf. Exhibit failure of subcanonicity.

stages.title: Étale cohomology and étale objects
stages.description: Apply the criterion to torsion étale cohomology and separated qcqs étale objects, finite étale schemes and constructible finite-set sheaves. Identify separated étale objects over aic valuation rings and the finite-chain category, without restricting its morphisms to injections.

stages.title: Constructible complexes, differentials and perfect schemes
stages.description: Prove continuity and arc-hyperdescent of bounded constructible complexes over a finite coefficient ring; compute their finite-rank valuation model. Establish characteristic-zero h-differential and h-de Rham arc-descent, and upgrade imported perfect-complex v-hyperdescent to arc-hyperdescent on perfect schemes, with the universally-effective-epimorphism criterion.

stages.title: Formal glueing and henselian rigidity
stages.description: Formal glueing along finite ideals, its sheafified pushout and small-limit-valued form; full Gabber affine proper base change, rigidity and punctured completion comparison; open and support cohomology with bounded torsion and noetherian multi-ideal variants.

stages.title: The arc_t-topology and rigid generic fibres
stages.description: Define arc_t-covers and arc_t-equivalences, prove finitary hyperdescent and invariance for torsion étale cohomology of completed generic fibres, compare covers with generic points of adic spectra, and prove proper rigid GAGA and total-integral-closure excision.

stages.title: Künneth and affinoid vanishing
stages.description: Prove generic-fibre and affinoid Künneth for coefficients of residue-invertible prime order, rational Mayer–Vietoris, shrinking-tube continuity and rational-domain vanishing. Deduce the d+1 bound for arbitrary torsion and the d bound for residue-prime-to-characteristic torsion on a d-dimensional affinoid over an algebraically closed nonarchimedean field.

stages.title: I-complete arc-covers and formal schemes
stages.description: Define I-complete arc-covers, their complete aic valuation tests and products-of-valuations basis. Prove étale hyperdescent on completed and punctured spectra for finitely generated ideals, compare with henselizations and construct the p-adic formal arc-site with its affine comparison.

stages.title: Perfectoid bases and integral hyperdescent
stages.description: Prove the perfectoid basis for the formal arc-site, structure-sheaf descent and acyclicity on perfectoids, representable formal-scheme descent on that basis, tilting invariance of complete arc-covers and p-complete hyperdescent for A, A-flat and A_inf. Export the precise completed-generic-fibre and proper-henselian comparisons needed by the routed consumers.
